description: The AWS source is not silent: the corpus holds an event from the last two hours. CloudTrail delivers about every five minutes, so two hours of silence means delivery or normalization has stopped

params.query: SELECT from_unixtime(max(time) / 1000) AS newest FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -1, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') HAVING max(time) > (to_unixtime(now()) - 7200) * 1000

matrix_rows.gap: The AWS source only. GCP's audit and data-access logs deliver to their own log bucket, outside the corpus, so their silence is not judged here.
